attchmntText: Vishwaraj Sugar Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vishwaraj Sugar Industries Limited board approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net loss of 1,977.30 lakh rupees for the quarter and 4,576.61 lakh rupees for the half-year. Revenue from operations stood at 10,706.68 lakh rupees for the quarter and 21,413.29 lakh rupees for the half-year. Basic earnings per share were negative 0.91 rupees for the quarter and negative 2.10 rupees for the half-year. Total assets were 66,106.65 lakh rupees as of September 30, 2026. The board also reviewed and amended company policies in accordance with the Companies Act 2013 and SEBI regulations. The limited review report was issued by statutory auditors P.G. Ghali and Co. on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Vishwaraj Sugar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Reconciliation of Share Capital under Regulation 76 of SEBI (DP), 2018'.
